To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the platform based solutions conception process should be based on the assessment of the changeability and comprehensiveness attributes of the platform to be designed.
the method is based on a set of attributes to assess platform changeability and comprehensiveness and to guide the platform based solution design.

the proposed method is a systems architecting approach for platform based solutions for satellites that helps the developers to: 1) assess the changeability of the platform to achieve future missions; 2) assess the comprehensiveness of the platform in terms of possible future missions; and 3) balance the changeability attributes with the platform comprehensivness attributes.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the conceptual design of satellite platform based solutions, with the aim to assess and balance the changeability and comprehensiveness attributes, in order to achieve future missions, with a minimum impact on the satellite mass and with minimum changes.

the method is a good tool to assess platform changeability and comprehensiveness attributes and to support the platform based solution conceptual design process.
the method promotes an efficient platform based satellite conception, with a minimum impact on the future mission modifications and with a maximum impact on the platform comprehensibility.
the method proposed is an efficient way to assess the platform balance between changeability and comprehensiveness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a systems architecting framework to assess the changeability and comprehensiveness attributes of a platform based solution for satellites, which can be used in a very early phase of the system life cycle to guide the platform conceptual design.
the method is a tool for the developers to assess and guide conceptual design of platform solutions for space missions.
the method helps the platform developers to achieve a balance on the platform changeability, comprehensiveness and efficiency attributes.

platform based solutions for satellites can be developed with an efficient and effective systems architecting approach.
the method is applicable to any space platform based solution and it can be used by any company in the space sector.
